skills.name: Lore (all subcategories of all creatures trained in Lore skills within 1 mile)

generalAbilities.name: Mycelium Network
generalAbilities.description: Psychic fungi are connected to a network of psychic filaments bonding all psychic fungi from the same colony. This network grants the harvester the ability to detect creatures capable of thought within 30 feet of a bonded psychic fungus up to 1,000 feet away as an imprecise sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Release Spores
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The harvester is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The harvester releases a cloud of spores in a 10ft Type:burst centered on a corner of its own space that lasts for 1 round. Each creature that's in the cloud or enters it is exposed to befuddling spores. If this reaction was triggered by damage from a melee attack, the triggering creature uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its roll for its Fortitude save (two degrees worse if it was a jaws Strike or other Strike with the creature's mouth).

offensiveAbilities.name: Befuddling Spores
offensiveAbilities.description:
Plants and fungi are immune

Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 Stupefied 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 Slowed 1 and Stupefied 3 (1 round)

Stage 4 Paralyzed and Stupefied 4 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Brain
offensiveAbilities.description: The elder psychic fungus consumes the fluids and psychic essences from the brain of a creature within 10 feet that has been dead for no more than 1 minute. The elder psychic fungus regains the use of their highest-ranked spent innate spell. The creature is considered to have died due to a death effect.
